interpretationFindings.finding: The pinned comparison records eight matching groups and seven unresolved flags: 62, 67, 68, 72, 73, 74 and 75. They include formula/heading placement, ਸ਼ਾਹ/ਸਾਹ, ਪ੍ਰੀਤ/ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, internal punctuation and vowel/adak differences. These drafts do not adjudicate those flags or clear the global 67-group source caveat.

Keep the original grouping: 61 has two lines, 62 has five including ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ, and 73 has three with a longer final line. Separate metrical headings occur at 62, 64 and 74. They do not become new numbered verses; no source line is split, combined or silently omitted.

The main bilingual explanations preserve prior meanings for ਅਭੀਤ and ਅਭੇ from 31, honour and treasury from 44, and the song image from 47. A changed stanza number does not require a changed interpretation. Context and alternative readings can be explained without rewriting the earlier lessons.

ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ is a reliance-on-Divine-strength formula beside the metrical transition in the comparison witnesses. The frozen package includes it as line01, so it receives an honest explanation while the following four short verse lines remain identifiable. This is not a newly discovered fifth metrical foot or a promise of personal power.

The first line includes four limits: cutting, piercing or breaking, naming and desire. The second has a substantive creator/conqueror split: Sant Sewa Singh gives creation with indwelling, while Neki gives overcoming all with indwelling. Preserve the selected analysis and its alternative without changing the spacing of ਸਮਸਤੋ ਪਰਾਜੀ.

Water and land name pervasion. Sant Sewa Singh and Neki distinguish fearlessness at ਅਭੀਤ from unfathomable mystery at ਅਭੇ; the derivative Bhai Vir Singh account instead contrasts not giving fear with being fearless. Keep that difference visible and maintain the prior working meanings from Chhand 31.

The four clauses concern sovereignty, ਅਜੂ, locality and guise. The selected birthless reading of ਅਜੂ follows Punjabi commentary and the prior lesson; immutable or motionless is a supported alternative. Being beyond one country or costume does not erase the presence in all countries and forms praised at 66.

Unfathomable depth, ਅਬਾਧੇ and bliss precede the repeated honour and treasury phrases. Unhindered and free-from-destruction readings of ਅਬਾਧੇ should remain distinct. Preserve both qualities of the opening pair and the prior honour/treasury meanings without claiming unanimous human belief or guaranteed material wealth.

Masterlessness is the selected reading of ਨ੍ਰਿਨਾਥੇ; the dictionary also records a ruler-of-people analysis. ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ has dissolution and churning interpretations, as in earlier lessons. The remaining epithets concern resistance to defeat, destruction or breaking. Divine power is not permission for a reader to harm others.

Beyond time and independent of an external nurturer are followed by presence in all lands and guises. Boundlessness is an alternative for ਅਪਾਲੇ. These Divine attributes do not devalue human dependence, carers, nationality, clothing or bodily needs.

The sequence includes sovereignty, making or arranging, another sovereign title, and moon imagery. ਮਾਹ is moon in the cited Jaap dictionary example; it is not the month or within homonym here. Preserve ਸ਼ਾਹ exactly in this source, while noting the ਸਾਹ witness without treating the title as a breath exercise.

Song and love lead into formidable ardour and drying or dissolution. The exact ਰੋਖ dictionary citation supports martial fervour; anger or wrath remains an alternative. ਸੋਖ is not silently replaced by ਸੁਖ or reduced to comfort. The severe images should remain visible without a claim that personal rage or cruelty is holy.

All four clauses need coverage: illness or affliction, enjoyment, conquest and fear. Commentary differs between illness as an aspect of Divine sovereignty and a breaking/destruction analysis. Do not turn the first into an assured cure or blame an ill person. Fear language describes the address and does not prescribe intimidation.

ਪਰਮ ਤਾਨੰ is read as supreme strength in Punjabi commentary and the derivative account, unlike the musical working sense of ਤਾਨ ਤਾਨੇ at 47. Neki’s attraction-related rendering remains separate. Preserve knowledge, strength, mantra and yantra as distinct ideas; describing their historical vocabulary does not promise supernatural efficacy.

Seeing, drawing toward, colours or delight, and the paired ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ ਅਨੰਗੇ all need explanation. The selected three-world dissolution and bodiless reading differs from Mahan Kosh’s Jaap-specific three-guna analysis. Its separate Krishna-posture and metre entries are not automatic meanings here; neither clause should disappear in a compressed paraphrase.

Life and seed imagery precede the paradox of being unprovoked or unaffected while compassionate toward all. Commentary readings include non-attachment, not being softened and indivisibility. The dictionary’s ਅਭਿਜ entry explicitly points its Jaap citation to fully knowing via ਅਭਿਗ sense 3. Retain the selected reading and this alternative; none demands human indifference to suffering.

Compassion and the ending of wrongful actions lead to a long final line about the enduring dwelling or source of ਰਿਧਿ and ਸਿਧੰ. Preserve both abundance and accomplishment or traditional spiritual-power senses. The line does not guarantee wealth, occult abilities or automatic erasure of responsibility through recitation.

ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿੱਤ ਕਰਮੇ and ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰਮੇ are not silently made identical: deathless or nectar-like action stands beside unimpeded or unbroken dharam. Union with all and enduring enjoyment or abundance complete the stanza. Preserve ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ and ਅਖੱਲ despite witness differences; neither nectar language nor union promises bodily immortality or a particular yoga result.

Steady sovereignty, enduring creation or arrangement, universal or unhindered dharam and unfathomable action are separate clauses. Universal scope does not certify every human custom as righteous. The all/whole lexical comparison does not authorize replacing ਅਖੱਲ with ਅਖਿਲ or dismissing the recorded spelling flag.

contentFindings: The frozen 58-line grouping is preserved, including the contextual invocation at 62.01 and the long third line at 73. Metrical headings remain separate at 62, 64 and 74.
All seven repeated explanations preserve their earlier bilingual mains: fear, mystery, birthlessness, honour, treasury, timelessness and song.

Creation with indwelling is the selected 61.02 reading from Sant Sewa Singh; Neki’s overcoming-all reading remains a substantive alternative. The unhindered/undestroyed alternatives at 64 also remain explicit.

The 65–68 descriptions retain masterlessness, dissolution, nurture-independence, every land and guise, sovereignty, making, lunar radiance, song, love, fierce resolve and drying or dissolution without flattening the distinct epithets.

At 69 illness is included within devotional praise without diagnosing its cause, blaming an ill person or promising a cure. Enjoyment, victory and fear remain separate; no human license to intimidate or conquer is implied.

At 70 the strength sense of ਤਾਨ is contextual and distinct from the earlier musical sense. The means-related jantra reading is attributed precisely to the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account alongside the Punjabi steeks’ all-jantra wording.

Both epithets of 71.04 are explained; three-world dissolution and bodilessness remain distinct from Mahan Kosh’s three-guna reading. At 72 the fully-knowing dictionary alternative remains separate from the selected non-attachment reading, with compassion explicit.

The long 73 line preserves abundance, attainment or traditional powers, continuity and dwelling. At 74 ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿੱਤ and ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ are distinguished without source edits; the universal-union and enduring-provision choices retain alternatives. At 75 steadfast creative power is not a claim that every created form is permanent.

No qualified review, source-edition clearance, canonical translation approval or public release approval is claimed. All six Anand 24 teachings and its Study remain absent; only original line03 carries the preserved held flag.
